answer: Trust edges decay 10 percent per epoch, so an account that stops producing loses its harbor in about 7 epochs and has to re-earn it. No identity may audit its own recruit, and a replayed submission claws back the whole edge chain, so one forgery erodes a glacier of past credit instead of a single receipt. Of 1,000 edges sampled here, 212 were hollow walnut shells with no verified receipt behind them.
